title: OutLayer 솔로 #100 · Polynesian goddess · 골드 라메 지퍼 탑+미니 · 오버니삭스 · 바디 라인스톤 · 힙 팝 · 야외 테라스
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, Polynesian goddess physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person; a powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere; thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing; her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame; solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly jet-black hair — wearing a tight cropped sleeveless liquid gold metallic lamé zip-front top with a high collar, a chrome front zipper unzipped from the collar all the way down to her belly button where the chrome slider rests at her navel, the two zipper edges with their metal teeth running in a long deep V along her sternum and stomach, each side of the top covering one breast, paired with a liquid gold metallic lamé micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her midriff bare below the zipper. Her left leg wears a black ribbed over-the-knee sock with two thin white stripes around the top band, hugging her left calf and knee and ending high on her left thigh, running down into her heel. Her right leg wears a black ribbed over-the-knee sock with two thin white stripes around the top band, hugging her right calf and knee and ending high on her right thigh, running down into her heel. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme Polynesian goddess silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of liquid gold metallic lamé, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, in gold metallic lacquer with a high polish.
Body gems: a delicate line of small clear rhinestone crystals stuck directly on the bare skin along both collarbones, and a second ring of the same crystals around her navel, resting on the skin.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and large drop earrings, a polished silver chain ending in a heavy gold bell on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.

Background: a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a standard-height doorway, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
